adjudicatedContradiction.claim: Applied migration 18 cannot be rewritten, but on a valid divergent revision-1 database it fails before any later append-only repair migration can execute.
adjudicatedContradiction.verdict: accepted fail-closed behavior, not an approved-constraint contradiction
rationale: The accepted design requires canonical identity collisions to fail closed and forbids destructive rewrite of applied migrations; a UNIQUE failure in migration 18 is that behavior.

Host bb.storage.migrate applies every pending statement inside one transaction (apps/server/src/services/plugins/plugin-api.ts:570; fake host packages/plugin-sdk/src/testing/fake-plugin-host.ts:919), so a failing 18 rolls back 18-21 atomically, keeps _bb_migrations at 0..17, and preserves all revision-1 rows - proven at the host runner in data.test.ts.

Revision-1 workflow_artifacts tables have no production writer in plugins/workflows/src (only workflow-terminal-settlement.ts writes post-foundation *_v2 tables) and no durable ledger on this host has applied migrations 14-21 (/Users/erik/.bb/plugins/workflows/data.db is at id 13), so divergent revision-1 data can arise only from tests or manual SQL.
Preempting or replacing migration 18 would require destructive migration authority, which the unit forbids; the accepted behavior is recorded as a risk with its precondition.
